title: Kadehte Rakı Beyazı
author: Burkay Adalığ
description: A definitive exploration of rakı, Turkey’s national spirit, weaving together history, production, and culture. Adalığ tackles myths and health aspects with a doctor’s eye, before celebrating the rakı table with tasting advice, meze recipes, and innovative cocktails. A warm tribute to one of the Mediterranean’s richest drinking traditions.
